main.description: One person's accept/decline response to a net.bisks.postwith.meeting proposal they received, written by createRecord (server-generated TID key) from the "accept"/"decline" buttons in the requests inbox. A meeting is considered accepted once the recipient posts a response with status "accepted" — there is no record update if they change their mind, only whatever the shared client-side index last saw. Written and read by postwith (https://postwith.bisks.net).

meetingUri.description: AT-URI of the net.bisks.postwith.meeting record this is a response to.

status.description: The response outcome. The UI only ever writes one of these two literal button values, so this is a strict enum (unlike the topic fields elsewhere in postwith).

createdAt.description: When this response was recorded, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
